summary: A prayer of one who feels forsaken and who asks whether the Lord’s loving kindness will be declared in the grave.
meta_description: A prayer of one who feels forsaken and who asks whether the Lord’s loving kindness will be declared in the grave.
section_headings: A Song or Psalm for the sons of Korah, to the chief Musician upon Mahalath Leannoth, Maschil of Heman the Ezrahite.
